# Jesus Feeds the Crowd (Matthew 14:19)

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness when Jesus takes our little and makes it enough.

## Key KJV
“And he took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples.” (Matthew 14:19)

## Gentle Retelling
A little boy shared his lunch with Jesus. Jesus thanked God, broke the bread and fish, and fed thousands of people. Everyone was full and thankful.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus blessing the small baskets while the crowd sits happily on the grass.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“When we give what we have and say thank You, Jesus makes it enough.”
